newsitem.title: USA: Boeing sees $124 billion China plane market.
newsitem.headline: Boeing sees $124 billion China plane market.

text.p: Boeing Co, which just signed a $685 million deal with China for five of its next-generation airliners, forecast a market for about 1,900 commercial jet airplane sales in China worth $124 billion over 20 years.

Boeing said forecasts, which included Hong Kong, would make China the largest international commercial airplane market. So far this year, Chinese airlines have placed orders for Boeing airplanes valued at $1.13 billion, it said.
Under an agreement signed Tuesday, China's aviation administration would order the five Boeing 777-200 aircraft for Chinese international carrier Air China.

The deal was signed by Ronald Woodward, president of Boeing Commercial Airplane Group, and Shen Yuankang, deputy director of the administration, in a ceremony at Beijing's Great Hall of the People witnessed by visiting U.S. Vice President Al Gore.
